title: Cultural nationalism: murals, indigenismo and modernism
goal: Describe the cultural movements of the 1920s with *a pesar de*, *a pesar de que* and *pese a*.

items: I can admit a contrast and go on, with *a pesar de*, *a pesar de que* or *pese a*.
I can say who painted the Mexican murals and where.
I can explain what indigenismo was, and that critics judge it differently today.
I can use the words *el mural*, *el pintor*, *la identidad* and *indígena*.
